notes: Single source of truth for the database spreadsheet, the Apps Script backend and the TypeScript types.
Timestamps are plain text 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.mmm' in plant-local time (no time zone). Dates are 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
Date/timestamp columns must be formatted as Plain Text in the sheet so Google Sheets never converts them.
Original upload text (code_raw, reason_raw) is always kept next to resolved ids.

tables.name: lines
tables.description: Reporting lines taken from the downtime sheet.

tables.name: areas
tables.description: Downtime areas (the EQUIPMENT column of the downtime sheet).

columns.name: active

columns.name: is_incident

columns.name: line_id

columns.name: is_area_level

columns.name: classification
columns.description: PRO, MEC, ELE, AUT, PL, CIR (upper case)

columns.name: is_void
columns.description: TRUE when voided; excluded from analysis, kept for audit

columns.name: accepted_by

columns.name: accepted_at

tables.name: event_edits
tables.description: One row per changed field when an event is edited or voided in the app. Keeps the original value.

tables.name: upload_warnings

columns.name: source_row
columns.description: Row number in the uploaded sheet

columns.name: detail
columns.description: Plain-English description with stored and uploaded values

tables.name: roles
tables.description: User roles.

tables.name: users
tables.description: App accounts. Created by an admin; empty in the delivered database (the first admin is created by the setup function).

columns.name: locked_until
columns.description: UTC ISO time until which sign-in is refused

tables.name: tab_access
tables.description: Tab level per role, with optional per-user overrides. A user override wins over the role.

tables.name: settings
tables.description: Admin-adjustable settings.

tables.name: audit_log
tables.description: Append-only log of every change.

tables.name: notifications
tables.description: Stored alerts and updates (docs/notifications-design.md). Action items are derived live by the app and are never stored. Written by the server only.

columns.name: dedupe_key
columns.description: Unique. One row per cause, e.g. long_stop|<event_id>, repeat|<area>|<code>|<reason_key>|<first_event_id>, spike|<area>|<yyyy-mm-dd>, upload_gap|<latest_event_date>, availability|<area>|<yyyy-mm>, upload|<batch_id>, planned|<area>|<yyyy-mm>, action_due|<action_id>|<due_date>, ready|<action_id>|<number of tasks>, task_due|<task_id>|<due_date>

columns.name: area_id
columns.description: References areas.area_id; blank when not about one area

columns.name: source_ref
columns.description: event_id, batch_id, user_id or action_id the notification is about

columns.name: status
columns.description: resolved = the condition no longer holds; expired = retention passed

columns.name: recipients
columns.description: 1.7.0: who sees it: comma-separated user ids and/or @closers (actions_closers and the Admins); blank = everyone

tables.name: notification_state
tables.description: Per user and notification: seen, snoozed or dismissed. One row per user and notification (upsert).

columns.name: snooze_until
columns.description: Plant-local time; only for state snoozed

tables.name: notification_prefs
tables.description: Per user notification preferences. One row per user and key (upsert).

columns.name: key
columns.description: alert_types (csv of notification types, blank = all) | watch_areas (csv of area ids, blank = all) | digest (none | daily | weekly) | last_seen_at (timestamp) | last_digest_at (timestamp, written by the server) | saved_views (JSON text, at most 20 saved views of the dashboards) | saved_reports (JSON text, at most 20 report templates) | theme (one of the five theme names, blank = none; 1.5.0)

tables.name: actions
tables.description: Improvement actions (docs/actions-design.md). Created by people or drafted by the server rules; one dedupe_key per cause keeps one open action for it.

columns.name: status
columns.description: 1.7.0: Draft until accepted; Open and In progress follow the tasks (In progress as soon as a task leaves Open); Closed (needs every task Done or Not needed) and Cancelled only by people in actions_closers (or an Admin)

columns.name: source_ref

columns.name: reason_key

columns.name: owner_kind
columns.description: Kind of the owner (follows the contractors row)

columns.name: owner

columns.name: assignee

columns.name: needs_stop
columns.description: The work needs the area stopped

columns.name: root_cause

columns.name: required_action
columns.description: What should be done, by whom

columns.name: closed_by
columns.description: user_id of the person who closed or cancelled it

columns.name: closed_at
columns.description: When it was closed or cancelled

columns.name: closure_note
columns.description: Why it was closed or cancelled

columns.name: effectiveness_checked_at
columns.description: When the verdict was last set

columns.name: evidence
columns.description: JSON list of {event_id?, note?, added_at, added_by}; at most 200 entries

columns.name: dedupe_key
columns.description: repeat|<equipment>|<reason_key>, chronic|<equipment>|<yyyy-mm>, long_stop|<event_id>, planned|<area>|<yyyy-mm>; at most one OPEN action per key

columns.name: template_id
columns.description: 1.7.0: task_templates.template_id the tasks were first made from; blank = none

tables.name: action_log
tables.description: History of every action: status changes, comments, edits and added evidence. Append-only.

columns.name: kind
columns.description: task_* (1.7.0) are about the task in task_id

columns.name: text
columns.description: Comment, summary of the change, or the closing note

columns.name: task_id

tables.name: action_tasks
tables.description: 1.7.0: the tasks (the work) of an action. Never deleted: a task that is not needed gets the status Not needed.

columns.name: title
columns.description: What has to be done, one line

columns.name: owner_kind
columns.description: Kind of the owner (follows the contractors row); internal when there is no owner

columns.name: owner
columns.description: contractors.contractor_id (external contractor or internal team); blank = nobody yet

columns.name: assignee
columns.description: Person doing or following the task: user_id or a free name; gets the overdue alert

columns.name: status
columns.description: Contractor informed only for an external contractor; Done needs a note and Not needed a reason (3+ characters)

columns.name: needs_stop
columns.description: The work needs the area stopped (Shutdown list)

columns.name: est_stop_h
columns.description: Estimated stop hours; blank = not estimated (always blank when needs_stop is FALSE)

columns.name: template_step
columns.description: Title of the template step it was made from; blank = added by hand

columns.name: done_at
columns.description: When it became Done or Not needed; blank while open

columns.name: done_note

tables.name: contractors
tables.description: External contractors and internal teams that own actions, with the areas each contractor is responsible for.

columns.name: contractor_id
columns.description: Short id, e.g. RHI, ASEC, MEC

columns.name: areas
columns.description: Comma-separated area ids (an area belongs to at most one active contractor)

tables.name: area_targets

columns.name: overhaul_months

tables.name: task_templates

columns.name: applies_to
columns.description: Comma-separated action sources the template is suggested for first (auto_repeat, auto_long_stop, manual ...); a source belongs to at most one active template

columns.name: active
columns.description: Switched-off templates are kept but not offered

tables.name: task_template_steps
tables.description: 1.7.0: the steps (tasks) of each task template, in order. Saving a template replaces all its steps.

columns.name: title
columns.description: Task title; unique within the template (kept on the task as template_step)

columns.name: default_owner

columns.name: due_offset_days

tables.name: user_activity
tables.description: Who used the app and when (1.6.0): one row per user, upserted by the server at most once every 3 minutes per user. Shown to Admins in Settings > Active users.

columns.name: last_page

columns.name: device

columns.name: updated_at
